packageRules.description: Everything except the Kit stack: detect and list on the Dependency Dashboard, open a PR only when ticked there
Moved by the Kit port (.github/upstream-port.md) together with gpui-kit
Kit releases: one PR on a fixed branch, which upstream-port.yml hands to Claude Code
prBodyNotes: The **Upstream port** workflow ports this Kit release with Claude Code and pushes the result here. When every check passes it labels the PR `port-ready`; **Upstream land** then merges it once CI is green and tags `material-v<version>`, which publishes the release.
